card.title: Choose the Relationship
card.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay home from the networking dinner. I've finally learned your mother's dumplings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director's coming. I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then staying would tell me I'm more than the person keeping dinner warm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Freeze them. We'll have them tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what you said on our anniversary. Call and say you've already got dinner with me.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 asks staying for a meaningful meal, A3 interprets career sacrifice as relational value and A5 demands naming dinner as an existing commitment.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 promotion opportunity causes A3 explicit priority comparison; B4 freezing and postponing cause A5 prior-anniversary evidence and cancellation request.

relationship.evidence: B2 values advancement and B4 offers a practical way to preserve the food while attending.

heightening.evidence: B4 solution misses the connection's time-sensitive meaning, so A5 names the repeated pattern and seeks a different choice.

specificity.evidence: A1 learned family dumplings and B2 networking establish the personal effort and competing benefit.
